verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirmed a machine-readable OpenAPI document is downloadable at docs.mangopay.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains the "openapi" key), so the story's core capability is directly delivered. The llms.txt and .md page variants are supplementary machine-readable docs, not the API spec itself. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or linking the OpenAPI spec, evidence of the spec's completeness and coverage of the full API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
